question: Create a box plot showing the distribution of TP53 expression levels across different tissue types. Include jittered data points (swarm or strip), proper axis labels, and a title.

files.eval_guideline: Box plot must show TP53 expression across tissue types with individual data points overlaid as jittered points; axis labels, color scheme, and jitter details may differ.
files.match_reasoning: The files have the identical basename and PNG image format, and both belong to task b-3-7. The name directly corresponds to the requested TP53 expression box plot.
files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline requires semantic visual features—a TP53 box plot grouped by tissue type with jittered individual points—while explicitly allowing stylistic differences. Semantic comparison is therefore appropriate for the PNG output.

comparison_details.explanation: Both images show box plots of TP53 expression for the same five tissue types—Brain, Breast, Colon, Liver, and Lung—with individual jittered observations overlaid. Their distributions agree closely: Colon has the highest median, Liver the lowest, Brain and Lung have similar intermediate medians, and Breast is below them. The medians, quartiles, whisker ranges, extrema, and notable low Liver observation are consistent, indicating that the same underlying data and scientific message are presented. Both include an appropriate title and labeled tissue-type and TP53-expression axes. Differences are cosmetic: the reference uses one box color and a shaded plotting background, whereas the candidate uses distinct colors, a white background, larger typography, and adds n=30 to each category label. Title capitalization and precise jitter positions also differ slightly, but none of these changes affects interpretation.
